verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm an official Pinecone SDK exists: backups can be managed "using the Pinecone SDK, API, or console," and the llms.txt describes the official docs as covering SDKs. Beyond those passing mentions, the evidence says nothing about which languages are supported or how deep the SDK coverage goes. missing for 10: list of supported SDK languages, SDK reference/quickstart documentation, evidence of SDK coverage across indexing/search/inference APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience.
